title: Best-Rate Guarantee Figures across the Hotel Rate Plans
content:
Five of the seven Hotel Rate Plans carry the best-rate guarantee. This schedule records which, for how long a lower public rate may be claimed, and what goodwill amount a settled claim carries.

| Rate plan | Best-rate guarantee carried | Claim window from booking, hours | Goodwill amount, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | no | 0 | 0.0 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | no | 0 | 0.0 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | yes | 24 | 25.0 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | yes | 24 | 25.0 |
| Member Flex Rate | yes | 48 | 50.0 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | yes | 48 | 50.0 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | yes | 72 | 100.0 |

The **claim window** is the number of hours after booking within which a lower public rate may be claimed, and the **goodwill amount** the sum added to an upheld claim. The two plans that do not carry the guarantee record 0 hours and 0.0 USD.

The window and the goodwill amount move together: 24 hours with 25.0 USD on the Semi-Flexible Rate and the Standard Flexible Rate, 48 hours with 50.0 USD on the Member Flex Rate and the Suite Flexible Rate, and 72 hours with 100.0 USD on the All-Inclusive Flex Rate.
